steps.text: Pulse 4 cups flour, yeast, and salt in food processor until combined. With food processor running, slowly add oil, then water; process until rough ball forms, 30 to 40 seconds. Let dough rest 2 minutes, the process 30 seconds more. (If, after 30 seconds dough is sticky and clings to blade, add remaining 0.25 cup flour 1 tbs at a time as needed.)

Transfer dough to lightly floured counter and knead by hand until smooth, round ball. Place dough in a large, lightly greased bowl; cover tightly with plastic and let rise at room temperature until doubled (1 to 1.5 hours).
